## SECTION 0 — OVERVIEW

My Base holds years 3–5 at +4.3%/yr (next-FY consensus revenue growth) with the desk's own long-run margin reversion to the 8-year operating-margin trend (12.3%) by year 10 already discounting the peak. ## SECTION 1 — MACRO

From DATA 1.5 / 1.6 (as of 2026-10-04/01):

- **Rates:** 10y nominal 5.24%, real 2.88%, breakeven 2.36%; curve +0.45% (steepening). **Exposure: net tailwind.** Heritage carries $1.39B of cash + fixed maturities [Actual, P1 balance sheet]; H1 2026 net investment income was $20.5M, +17.3% y/y [Actual, P1]. Every 100bp on the invested asset base is roughly $8–9M of pre-tax income.
- **Regime:** goldilocks 0.341 headline but contested (margin 0.070); tightening 0.176, recession 0.081. High-for-longer rates support the investment annuity; a rate cut cycle would erode it — already embedded in my 10-year fade to 3.75% terminal growth.
- **Active shock:** `oil_shock` (severity 1, up, onset 2026-09-28) with CPI 3.35% / PCE 3.42% YoY. **Exposure: headwind on claim severity** — inflation in construction, labor and repair costs raises the loss ratio of a property book; this is why I do not extrapolate Q2's 30.4% loss ratio forward and why my Bear carries adverse development.
- **Credit:** IG spread 1.49%, HY 3.10% — loose; no portfolio credit stress signal in the filings (realized losses −$0.02M H1 2026 [Actual, P1]).
- Dominant idiosyncratic macro factor: the Atlantic season (runs to Nov 30). NOAA's outlook is a below-normal 2026 season with El Niño suppression [Estimate, noaa.gov + Naples News 2026-10-02]; Tropical Storm Fay's remnants dissipated Oct 2. This supports Base/Bull probabilities but does not eliminate a single-storm Bear.

## SECTION 2 — BUSINESS & MOAT

**Economic engines (mandate 1):**

1. **Transactional delivery — residential property underwriting.** H1 2026 GWP $735.2M, −4.1% y/y [Actual, P1]. The decline is *deliberate repositioning*: commercial-residential PIF −12.7% y/y on competitive Florida pricing pressure, while personal-residential PIF is **+1.2%** ($1.163B) and "other" +5.8% [Actual, P1 supplemental]. Total PIF $1.41B (−1.4%), total insured value $368.3B (+0.9%).
2. **Captive installed base / recurring annuity.** 350,887 policies-in-force renewing annually; unearned premiums of **$738.4M** at 2026-06-30 [Actual, P1] ≈ six months of net premium already locked in at current rates (H1 NPE $400.8M). Plus the investment annuity on the $1.39B invested asset base (H1 NII $20.5M [Actual, P1]).
3. **Strategic optionality.** Texas surplus-lines entry (CEO: contribution grows over 2–3 years [Estimate, Q2 call transcript 2026-08-06]); expanded reinsurance-partner capacity; AI-driven analytics; M&A "as opportunities emerge" [Actual, P1 initiatives].

**Owner earnings after SBC (mandate 2):** TTM owner earnings **$0.221B** [Arithmetic, DATA 3: NI $0.215B + D&A $0.013B − capex $0.007B]. SBC is immaterial ($5M FY2025 [Actual, DATA 5]) and is counted once — expensed in net income, so `sbc_treatment = deducted_in_cf`. The TTM OCF−NI gap of +$0.077B (OCF $0.305B vs NI $0.215B) is working-capital timing — prepaid reinsurance premiums +$153.7M y/y offset by reinsurance payable/unpaid-loss swings [Actual, P1 balance sheet] — recurring only while reserve development stays favorable; it is **excluded** from the base (why I value owner earnings $0.221B, not the $0.292B cash basis).

**Moat (7 factors, 0–3):** cost advantage (reinsurance arbitrage: $63.2M annualized CAT XOL savings [Estimate, Q2 call transcript]) **2**; switching costs (annual renewals, agent-intermediated) **1**; network effects **0**; intangibles (FL surplus-lines licenses, multi-state footprint, agent network) **2**; scale ($847M revenue, super-regional) **1**; underwriting discipline/operational excellence (CR 64.9%, deliberate unprofitable-line runoff) **2**; capital strength (net liquidity +$0.481B, debt-to-capital 11%) **2**. **Total 10/21 → moat 2.9/5.0, direction improving.** This is a discipline-and-reinsurance moat, not a structural one — the franchise can be competed away in Florida, which is exactly what my Bear prices.

**Financial strength:** equity $567.7M (BVPS $19.09, +54.5% y/y) [Actual, P1]; net liquidity +$0.481B [Arithmetic, DATA 6]; long-term debt $71.3M; Piotroski 6/7; accruals 0.0057 [Arithmetic, DATA 7].
